title: Kernel collocation + attention-specialized prefill/decode scheduling experiment
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Investigation and prototype to bring kernel-selection metadata into the scheduling path and expose attention-specialized execution modes at phase boundaries. Goal: reduce tail latency for short interactive requests while preserving throughput for long-prefill workloads. This ticket covers design, microbenchmarks, a canary proto, and rollout gating metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype scheduler can query kernel affinity metadata (quantized vs fp16 kernels) and schedule microphases accordingly
Attention-specialized fastpath reduces median latency for <64-token decode requests by >=10% on A100 and equivalent on other devices in testbed
End-to-end tail (p95/p99) for mixed traffic does not regress >5% compared to baseline when canary is enabled
Automated microbench suite and dashboard added; PRs with tests merged
Runbook for fallback and safe rollback documented and validated in staging
design_notes: Motivation: current runtime separates kernel selection (offline/per-model) from runtime scheduling, causing suboptimal kernel switches at phase boundaries and higher tail for short-latency requests.

Proposal: attach a lightweight kernel-affinity tag to in-flight requests; scheduler uses tag to collocate prefill and early decode microphases on devices/kernels with low-attention-overhead (attention-specialized kernels).

Attention specialization: implement two execution modes - 'dense-attn-fastpath' (optimized layout + memory streaming for short contexts) and 'bulk-prefill' (throughput-optimized, aggressive KV batching).
Phase boundary logic: on token count thresholds and KV-cache size, the scheduler may switch mode; we prefer switching at microphase boundaries to avoid cache thrash.
Fairness & cost: introduce token-weighted fairness to avoid starving long prefill batches; use proportional allotment of fastpath slots per customer for a fair mix of latency and throughput.
Interplay with kernels: kernel selection hints are advisory; runtime probes fallback automatically if kernel or device lacks capability.
implementation_plan: 1) Add kernel-affinity metadata to request envelope and surface on the scheduler RPC (minor schema bump)
2) Implement attention-mode enum in runtime exec: dense-attn-fastpath, bulk-prefill, default
3) Scheduler heuristic: short-decoder-first detection -> prefer fastpath; long-prefill detection -> prefer bulk-prefill; incorporate proportional fairness token budget per slice
4) Add micro-bench harness to perf-runner for A100/RTX/H100 to capture median/p95/p99 across sequence-length buckets
5) Instrument cost counters and per-request kernel switch counts for regression analysis
6) End-to-end canary: add toggle behind feature-flag and deploy to dedicated canary heap with synthetic and production shadow traffic
7) Iterate on heuristics based on bench results and user-facing SLOs
test_plan: Unit tests for request envelope schema and scheduler RPC changes
Integration tests: end-to-end on simulators that emulate kernel availability and attention kernel failure modes
Microbench matrix: run combinations (model size x seq length x batch size x kernel mode) and compare throughput/latency/cost
Canary plan: 2-week canary — 5% production traffic, mixed short-chat workload (<=64 tokens) and long-batch prefill workload (>=512 tokens)
Chaos test: force kernel probe failures and verify automatic fallback without request loss
Regression gate: p95/p99 and cost-per-token must meet release acceptance thresholds
rollout_plan: Feature-flagged in staging for 48h with synthetic and replayed traces
Canary: enable on small dedicated shard with 5% production shadow traffic, monitor 72h
Progressive rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over two weeks if no regressions
Immediate rollback criteria: p99 latency increase >8% for >=1h or elevated error rate (>0.1% increase)
Post-rollout: collect 2 weeks of telemetry and run A/B analysis against baseline
blockers: Kernel metadata schema approval (runtime + scheduler teams)
Access to stable perf lab slots on H100 for cross-device validation
Design review for fairness token-budget algorithm pending PM sign-off
